Constructor parameter coown is stored directly into coOwner.
Constructor computes prices and aids chances with unchecked multiplication and division.
Constructor writes each Ho entry into the hoes array.
manager state variable is read by the restricted modifier check.
msg.sender is compared against manager inside restricted.
restricted modifier gates entry to withdraw.
restricted modifier gates entry to sendMoney.
withdraw performs an external value transfer to coOwner.
withdraw performs an external value transfer to manager.

buyHo computes msg.value*160/100 without overflow checks when updating buyPrice.
index parameter selects the Ho struct accessed in buyHo.

index parameter selects the Ho struct accessed in rentHo.
